prompts.rabbit:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an alternative to the dog sprite in Shovey Classic, a top-down tile puzzle.
Exactly ONE isolated animal, viewed from directly overhead, head toward the TOP of the image, body vertical. We see its back, not a side portrait. Match a tiny clean 32x32 pixel-art animal like a readable green turtle: draw on a very coarse virtual 32x32 grid, enlarge with nearest-neighbor square pixel blocks. Aim for only 6-8 flat colors and 3 simple shading regions. Bold, clear cute silhouette; a dark 1-pixel outline; highlight from upper left. The whole animal fits within 22 pixels wide and 27 high on the virtual grid.
Genuine transparent background, nothing underneath the animal. No ground, shadow, floor, labels, frames, text, borders, other animals or props. No tiny fur lines, stippling, noise, fine texture, realistic rendering, blur, antialiasing, excessive detail, 3D or a side-facing camera.
Subject: one small cream-white RABBIT, two long distinct ears pointing upward, two tiny dark eyes at the top of the head, compact rounded body, two small visible hind feet and round white tail at the bottom. Subtle pale warm-gray body shading with just a small muted light-orange inner-ear accent. Clean and friendly, instantly recognizable from above.

prompts.crab:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game sprite for Shovey Classic, a clean small pixel-art top-down tile puzzle.
Create exactly ONE small orange CRAB, viewed directly overhead, front facing the TOP. Round compact warm-orange shell, two very clear raised pincers at upper left and upper right, two tiny dark eyes on short stalks at top, three chunky little legs on each side. Slight darker terracotta underside and pale light-orange highlight at upper left. Cute, clean, instantly recognizable at tiny size, anatomically readable from above.
Draw on a very coarse virtual 32 by 32 pixel grid with big square pixels and a crisp one-pixel dark outline, enlarged by nearest neighbor. Only 6-8 flat colors; no individual hair, surface stipple or tiny noise. The complete animal fits inside about 27 pixels wide and 25 high on that virtual grid, centered.
Genuine transparent background; no floor, sand patch, water, scene, shadow, props, lettering, frame or extra animals. No realistic texture, smooth shading, antialiasing, blur, 3D rendering, side view or perspective portrait.
